content: उद्यम् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (<ab>P.</ab> in some cases) .²1 To raise, elevate, lift up; बाहू उद्यम्य <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; परस्य दण्डं नोद्यच्छेत् <ls>Ms. 4. 164</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 280</ls>; धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः <ls>Bg. 1. 20</ls>; <ls>R. 15. 23</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 17</ls>; भारमुद्यच्छते <ls>Sk.</ls>; <ls>Bk. 4. 31</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">17. 92</ls>. .²2 To offer, give. .²3 To prepare, become ready for, begin, set about (with <ab>dat.</ab>, <ab>loc.</ab> or <ab>inf.</ab>); उद्यच्छमाना गमनाय पश्चात् <ls>R. 16. 29</ls>; <ls>Bk. 8. 47</ls>; see उद्यत. .²4 To strive, be diligent, strive hard for; उद्यच्छति वेदम् <ls>Sk.</ls> .²5 To reign, manage, govern. .²6 To keep back, stop, hinder. .²7 To rise. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To prompt, stimulate; मधुमदोद्यमिता वनिता <ls>Ki. 9. 66</ls>.
